gripOrHq.title: Cloak
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [3] from the bank on Cloak when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

gripOrHq.title: Vewy Vewy Quiet
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Vewy Vewy Quiet when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

gripOrHq.title: Hunt Club BBS
gripOrHq.rulesText: Expose up to three installed cards.

heapOrArchives.title: Ice and Data’s Guide to the Net
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Expose the outermost ice of each data fort.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Signpost
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: +2 link. Use this ability only once during each trace attempt, and only after you and the Corp have revealed how much each of you spent.

scoreArea.title: Polymer Breakthrough
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [1] at the start of each of your turns.

rig.title: Smarteye
rig.rulesText: Once during each run, you may expose a piece of unrezzed ice as you approach it. You may then jack out before the Corp decides whether to rez the ice.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Short-Term Contract
rig.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

ice.title: Laser Wire
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Bolter Cluster
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 4 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.

approachedIce.title: Bolter Cluster
approachedIce.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 4 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.
